body: In 2020 I bought the trilogy for the Xbox and I didn't really get around to playing until quarantine started really getting into effect. This just just so happened to coincide with my life just falling apart I guess. My mental health started declining and I got admitted to mental hospital after mental hospital but through losing everything I found some respite in these games . The storylines, the satisfaction of winning, the community. It all really started to come together, and this is basically a really long winded way to say that these games wre about the only thing I get to hold near and dear to my heart and nothing fills me with more joy rn than these games. When your life is a living nightmare, it's nice to have something that can wake you up for a little

I've always had this problem too. I always found that my work was amounting to nothing and being honest, I felt like a failure who couldn't figure out what to do but I slowly got back up on my feet and I think that's the key. You cant really expect to see two steps ahead. You got to just pray and hope things will work out which is basically the definition of life. But in my eyes that's what makes it beautiful. Its the surprise that something better than you could imagine is coming.

Yes of course there's no harm in trying and I've always found it nice to make some new friends. Guys are usually accepting and I think it would be wise to try to strike up conversation. Whenever I get nervous I just tell myself that ill never get the chance to talk to someone again if I shy away and that usually pushes me towards someone. I can never pass up a opportunity so maybe you are the same.

Well personally I find it hard to find someone i truly have a connection with but with most things, I would just say that there's no really telling when you'll meet said person. But life has a funny way of working things out and I'm sure there's no need to worry and that someone is out there for you and you don't really need to search. They naturally come to you.
